question: The independent audit of cycle 39870661520 verified the measurement layer but rejected the snapshot on three packaging defects: D1 both machine records carry run_id='local_verification' instead of the dispatch id, D2 state/evaluation.json was not updated, D3 the run is an undisclosed byte-duplicate of accepted 39854748616 with no re-open trigger fired. The round-1 repair dispatch (run 39872787455) then failed operationally at its producer step and persisted a snapshot byte-identical to the rejected one. Can the inherited snapshot be made audit-ready by a metadata-only provenance rebind plus state reconciliation that discharges D1-D3, re-runs NO accepted benchmark, and preserves every claim-bearing artifact verbatim?
why_this_cycle_not_a_rerun: The audit explicitly ordered: 'Do not re-run the falsification a sixth time for this repair: the frozen measurement stands (pins verified, auditor re-execution reproduces it exactly); the repair is provenance/state reconciliation only.' This cycle therefore performs NO benchmark invocation. It diagnoses the failed repair run, rebinds the already-measured records to a self-identifying dispatch envelope, writes the missing state block, and discloses the duplicate lineage. Re-running the wrapper (a sixth byte-identical execution on unchanged product head fe219a19) would repeat the exact zero-delta pathology that caused the REVISE.
hypothesis: H1-H7 hold: (H1) the persisted snapshot of operationally failed run 39872787455 (commit a07602e4858920902d926e75267619642261e0b1) is byte-identical to the rejected producer tree of 39870661520, so no partial repair work exists and the rejected measurement must be preserved, not replaced; (H2) the source measurement records are internally sound - PRODUCT_FALSIFIED (exit 1), 18 gates = 11 passed / 4 failed / 3 reported, run_valid=true, input_drift=[], non-vacuity 4/4 hold, product mount head fe219a197e4bfb129984a732ab9adca917556eac - and re-hashing the frozen inputs reproduces the recorded pins; (H3) the wrapper record local_verification.json is a byte-duplicate of accepted run 39854748616's record except exactly {run_id, generated_at_utc, engine_record_path}, and the engine record is a duplicate of the accepted 39806933576 engine record except {run_id, generated_at_utc, product_mount_head}; (H4) a metadata-only rebind can publish new records that self-identify the current dispatch (run_id=39873360672), disclose measurement_origin_run_id=39870661520, preserve the original files verbatim, and copy every measurement-bearing key unchanged; (H5) state/evaluation.json can be reconciled to satisfy every RESEARCH_PROTOCOL mandatory field, reference all new artifacts, record accepted_run_id=39866970583, keep continue_recommended=false, and explicitly state the duplicate lineage plus the re-adjudication of all three re-open triggers as NOT FIRED; (H6) no frozen bar, rubric, benchmark, test input or product file is modified and no universal-174k benchmark is run; (H7) the resulting snapshot is audit-ready: every gate above passes and every planted-drift control detects its planted defect.
baseline: The rejected producer snapshot a07602e4 (identical to run 39870661520 team, preserved as attempt artifacts), the accepted byte-duplicate record results/evaluation/minimal_retrieval_ca_benchmark/39854748616.json, the accepted evaluation tip 75f852ae84fc99cc1cd155ad852529ec5eb9624f, the accepted product head fe219a197e4bfb129984a732ab9adca917556eac, and the audit gate results/audit/evaluation/CYCLE_39870661520_GATE.json. No new measurement is produced; the baseline measurement is adopted with disclosed provenance.

gates.G0_freeze_first_pins_hold: the hypothesis, freeze record, frozen bars (RULES_LABEL 4457e971..., RULES_GEOMETRY a7452748..., VERDICT_CONTRACT b9cdb894...), the two source records, the source report, and the accepted duplicate record (8066eb4d...) all re-hash to their frozen digests before any claim is emitted.
gates.G1_snapshot_lineage_and_failure_diagnosi: commit a07602e4 is an ancestor of HEAD; origin/cycle/core/evaluation/39872787455/team and .../39870661520/team (when present) resolve to a07602e4; the committed diagnosis evidence records run 39872787455 as conclusion=failure with team step 'Run lane cycle' failed, 'Validate active MVP producer state' and 'Enforce lane write scope' skipped, audit/integrate skipped and resilience success; attribution of the direct cause is explicitly hedged because job logs are not retrievable without admin rights (HTTP 403).
gates.G2_source_provenance_defect_reproduced: both source machine records carry run_id='local_verification' (not 39870661520), the source report filename carries the same mislabel, and the wrapper's documented default is args.run_id or $GITHUB_RUN_ID or 'local' - reproducing audit defect D1 as a fact rather than an assertion.
gates.G3_duplicate_disclosure_verified: diffing the source wrapper record against accepted 39854748616 differs on exactly {run_id, generated_at_utc, engine_record_path}; diffing the source engine record against accepted 39806933576's engine record differs on exactly {run_id, generated_at_utc, product_mount_head}; all gate payloads and the full measurement are equal. This is the D3 duplicate disclosure, published, not hidden.
gates.G4_measurement_integrity_without_reexecu: from the committed source record only (no wrapper/engine invocation): verdict=PRODUCT_FALSIFIED, exit_code=1, n_gates=18, n_passed=11, n_failed=4, n_reported=3, failed-gate set equals the accepted four, run_valid=true, input_drift=[], non_vacuity.all_hold=true, product_mount_head=fe219a19, and the three V3 bundle digests equal the accepted state pins.
gates.G5_rebind_records_self_identify: new wrapper and engine rebind records exist under results/evaluation/minimal_retrieval_ca_benchmark/ named with run 39873360672, carry run_id=39873360672 and measurement_origin_run_id=39870661520, name and sha256 the preserved source files, set rebind_method='metadata_only_no_benchmark_reexecution', and reproduce every source measurement key verbatim (only the disclosed rebind envelope keys differ).
gates.G6_state_contract_complete: state/evaluation.json has direction_version=63, cycle_status=COMPLETE, proposed_run_id=github_run=39873360672, acceptance_status=PROPOSED_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT, accepted_run_id=39866970583, continue_recommended=false, human_gate_ready=false, machine_gate_ready=false, evidence_refs_n==len(evidence_refs), every evidence_ref path exists, the new artifacts are referenced, and next_recommendation discloses the byte-duplicate lineage, D1/D2/D3 discharge, and the three re-open triggers adjudicated NOT FIRED with their basis.
gates.G7_no_benchmark_reexecution_and_frozen_u: the instrument source contains no import or subprocess invocation of evaluation.minimal_retrieval_ca_benchmark / evaluation.mapping_free_recall_falsifier; it records benchmark_reexecuted=false and network_calls=[]; git diff against accepted tip 75f852ae shows no modification of evaluation/frozen_bars/**, evaluation/minimal_retrieval_ca_benchmark.py, evaluation/mapping_free_recall_falsifier.py or any product file.
gates.G8_diagnosis_evidence_structured: results/evaluation/orchestration/39872787455_diagnosis.json parses, carries the REST job/step facts, the snapshot byte-equality facts, an explicit inference hedge for the unretrievable log, and the D1-D3 remediation mapping to this cycle.

controls.C1_planted_digest_drift_is_detected: an in-memory pin map with one frozen digest byte-flipped must fail G0.
controls.C2_planted_duplicate_diff_is_detected: an in-memory source record with one extra differing measurement key must fail G3.
controls.C3_planted_state_ref_break_is_detected: an in-memory state copy with a nonexistent evidence_ref must fail G6.
controls.C4_planted_rebind_run_id_mismatch_is_det: an in-memory rebind record with run_id=39872787455 must fail G5.
controls.C5_planted_measurement_tamper_is_detecte: an in-memory source record with n_passed changed from 11 to 12 must fail G4.

population: the persisted snapshot commit a07602e4 and its three added files; the accepted duplicate record 39854748616; the accepted 39806933576 engine record; the frozen bars and mapping-free freeze pins; the accepted evaluation tip 75f852ae; the accepted product head fe219a19; the GitHub REST job/step facts for run 39872787455 captured at 2026-10-22T23:42Z; and this cycle's own state/rebind/report artifacts. No new packet, bundle, retrieval, label or geometry measurement.
claim_ceiling: This instrument establishes exactly one thing: that the rejected cycle 39870661520 snapshot can be made audit-ready by discharging its three packaging defects (D1 provenance, D2 state, D3 duplicate disclosure) with a metadata-only rebind that re-runs no benchmark and preserves every claim-bearing artifact verbatim, and that the inherited measurement still matches its frozen pins and the accepted duplicate record. It is NOT a new falsification, NOT a new retrieval/counter-authority/label/geometry/serve measurement, does NOT move or meet LABEL_SOUND or GEOMETRY_SOUND (both stay REPORTED-ONLY and unmet on the v3 bytes), lifts no DO-NOT-SERVE order, certifies no packet admission, does not claim jurist usefulness, keeps human_gate_ready and machine_gate_ready false, and runs no obsolete universal-174k benchmark. The PRODUCT_FALSIFIED finding remains the finding of runs 39852758814/39854748616 and is adopted unchanged.
freeze_first_disclosure: This hypothesis and its freeze record are committed BEFORE the claim-bearing repair instrument is executed. The instrument re-hashes both at execution start and refuses to run (exit 2) if either digest drifted. If any gate fails, the failure is reported verbatim and no success claim is issued in this cycle.
network_policy: zero network at instrument execution: it reads committed files, local git objects and the mounted product worktree; the REST job capture is a pinned committed input file recorded before the freeze.
determinism: SHA-256 hashing, exact string equality, exact JSON field comparison; no RNG, threshold, model or timestamp-bearing predicate.
